display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Helsinki puts you in the captain's seat over the real Helsinki.

THE REAL HELSINKI
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Cathedral and the Senate Square, Uspenski, the Central Station, the Parliament, Oodi, Finlandia Hall, the Rock Church, the Olympic Stadium and its tower, Linnanmaki, Kallio Church, Tripla, Majakka, the SkyWheel, Suomenlinna, the Harmaja lighthouse, Keilaniemi's towers. Helsinki-Vantaa with all three runways, Malmi, Nummela and Hyvinkaa. Trains, trams, the Tallinn ships and the Suomenlinna ferries.

THE WHITE NIGHT
A low golden sun from the north-west on the dome and the harbour, then full night with the city lit.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar in the South Harbour, the Cathedral out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
The city approach, the archipelago run through the islands, into the South Harbour past Suomenlinna, Nuuksio and the lakes, a fighter scramble, Helsinki by night and a city tour. Live air traffic control on the radio.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.

Switch every menu between English and Finnish in Settings.
